preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'data') and hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right'))
preconditions.description: The root is either None or a valid tree node with data, left, and right attributes.
If root exists, its data value is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'data') and hasattr(root.left, 'left') and hasattr(root.left, 'right')))
preconditions.description: If root exists, its left child is either None or a valid node.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'data') and hasattr(root.right, 'left') and hasattr(root.right, 'right')))
preconditions.description: If root exists, its right child is either None or a valid node.

postconditions.description: The return value is a list.
If the tree is empty, the result is an empty list.

postconditions.expression: root is not None and return_value[0] == root.data
postconditions.description: If the tree is not empty, the first element of the result is the root's data.

postconditions.expression: root is not None and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the result list are integers.

postconditions.expression: root is not None and len(return_value) == sum(1 for node in _all_nodes(root))
postconditions.description: The length of the result equals the total number of nodes in the tree.

postconditions.expression: root is not None and return_value == _preorder_recursive(root)
postconditions.description: The returned list matches the preorder traversal sequence (Root, Left, Right) of the tree.

semantic_helpers._all_nodes: A function that returns a list of all nodes in the tree in any order, used to count total nodes.
semantic_helpers._preorder_recursive: A function that returns the preorder traversal list of the tree using the standard recursive definition: [root.data] + _preorder_recursive(root.left) + _preorder_recursive(root.right), with base case [] for None.
